facebookresearch_meru/meru/utils/checkpo.create_CheckpointManager: create a CheckpointManager to periodically save PyTorch models and optimizers during training

facebookresearch_meru/meru/utils/distrib.gather_tensors_across_processes: gather tensors from multiple GPU processes into a list preserving order by rank
facebookresearch_meru/meru/utils/distrib.check_main_process: check if the current process is the main process for logging and checkpointing
